_note: Escape endings. Every clip starts on images/hallway.jpg and is pinned to a generated destination plate as image_end, exactly like the monster event clips. The room-transition `common` in regen_config.json cannot be reused here: it says 'preserve exact architecture, empty environment', which fights a clip whose whole job is to leave the station.
_common_note: Two separate strings on purpose. The first attempt used one shared `common` carrying 'walk through an opening doorway', which Flux painted INTO the destination plate — every ending arrived at a view framed by a doorframe, so the clip stopped on the threshold instead of walking out. The still must describe only where you end up; the doorway belongs to the video alone.
stillCommon: realistic cinematic sci-fi concept photograph, vertical mobile portrait framing, awe and scale, hopeful, the view filling the entire frame edge to edge, already standing out in the open space, no doorway, no door frame, no hatch, no airlock frame, no interior corridor, no walls, no people, no readable text, no watermark
videoCommon: realistic cinematic sci-fi vertical mobile portrait shot, smooth forward camera walk through an opening doorway and all the way out into a vast bright space, the doorway passing out of frame behind the camera, awe and relief, hopeful ending, no people, no readable text, no logos, no watermark, no creature, professional atmospheric game footage
negative: person, face, body, creature, readable text, logo, watermark, cartoon, painting, melting architecture, collapsing room, explosion, gore, horror, menacing, darkness, tessellated pattern, repeating texture, mosaic tile, grid pattern, kaleidoscope, fractal artifact
